{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 端插件：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立提示音与音量，内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件，Web 设置面板可配置。","id":"gh:1335332435","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-sound","slug":"AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 端插件：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立提示音与音量，内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件，Web 设置面板可配置。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-sound"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the **Web UI**: play a customizable sound when a task
finishes, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"and an attention sound whenever something needs a human."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 📬 **Submitted to Awesome DSH Plugin** — PR #752 (pending maintainer approval)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Six independent events"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Each event type has its **own sound and its own volume** (0–100%):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Event | Detection | Default sound |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Turn end / background task completed | `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'completed'`; job → `compl"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"eted` | Chime |
| Approval request | `approval/requested` frame | Ding |
| User question | `question"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"/requested` frame (not plan-review shaped) | Ding |
| Plan review | `question/requested` frame class"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ified as plan-review | Ding |
| Goal blocked | goal projection enters `blocked` | Ding |
| Backgroun"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"d / loop failure | job → `failed`; `turn/end` `error`; `host/agent-error` | Bell |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Completion** respects the “quiet current session” option; **attention** events (approval /
quest"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ion / plan-review / goal-blocked / failure) always ring.
- User abort, killed jobs, and `max-tokens`"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" / `blocked` / `interrupted` turns stay silent.
- Events come from `events.mux` plus `events.host`. "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"Mux-open replay of still-pending
approval/question frames (refresh recovery) does not ring; each `rp"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"cId` rings at most once.
- When the event stream is unavailable or frames fail to unwrap, the plugin"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" falls back to
snapshot diffing.
- **Multiple tabs**: the same event rings only once (BroadcastChann"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"el tie-break). A single
tab plays immediately, with no 40 ms handshake."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Separate subagent channel"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Subagent-originated events are detected and routed independently from the main agent:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **One-shot subagent jobs** — a `session/jobs` entry with `kind === 'subagent'` (each
parallel dele"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"gation completing used to ring the main completion sound; now it does not).
- **Subagent sessions** "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"— events whose session row is marked `origin: 'subagent'` /
`parentId` (continuable subagents), incl"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"uding child-session turn ends, approvals,
questions, goal projections, and failures."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The settings panel adds a **子代理事件 / Subagent Events** section with six rows (same sound
sources and "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"per-row volume as the main events) plus an **ignore all subagent events** master
switch. All six sub"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"agent sounds default to **mute**; main-agent events are unchanged."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Sound sources"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Each event picks one sound from a **Radio.Button group** in the settings panel:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Built-in synthesized sounds** — Ding / Chime / Bell / Complete / Success, generated live
with We"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"b Audio, no audio files required.
- **Mute** — silence that event.
- **Local file** — choose any MP3"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"/WAV/etc. file; a **file picker appears below the event row**
once selected. Uploaded files are stor"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ed in IndexedDB (`dsh-sound-audio`), immune to the
localStorage quota."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Settings panel (Settings → 声音通知 / Sound Notification)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The master switch and config export/import stay visible; a **主 Agent / 子代理** tab bar
switches the pa"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nel between the six main event rows and the subagent panel (its own six rows
plus the 「忽略子代理事件」/ ign"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ore-all-subagent-events switch). Each event row has a volume
slider on the title row and a Radio.Gro"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"up of Radio.Button options below — click to select
and play; a local-file row with a choose/replace "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"button appears when 本地文件 is selected."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Requires a DSH version with bundle-plugin support (`dsh.profile.bundles` + `dsh.bundle.patch`)
and `"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"pnpm` on PATH (`corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Other profiles work the same way: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @ai-galaxy/dsh-sound`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"To track unreleased `main`, install from the GitHub source instead:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Manual install (without pnpm)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"1. Copy this package and its runtime deps (`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`,
`@deepseek-ai/cosmokit`, `@st"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"andard-schema/spec`) into
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Compatibility & capability disclosure"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Compatibility**"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Node.js: `>=20` (`engines.node`).
- DSH: verified on `0.1.5-alpha.1`, `0.1.5-alpha.2`, `0.1.5-rc.1"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"`, `0.1.5-rc.2` —
declared as `compatible` in `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`; the plugin was also
s"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"moke-tested end-to-end (settings panel + live event sounds) on a source build of
`0.1.3-alpha.1`.
- "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"Verification (2026-09-13): each declared version passed a disposable-profile cycle —
`dsh plugin --p"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"rofile web add <tarball>` → `dsh web --no-open` boots and serves the
plugin bundle (`@ai-galaxy/dsh-"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"sound/client.js` present in the boot page, no plugin
load errors) → `dsh plugin --profile web remove"},{"id":"p32s7","text":" @ai-galaxy/dsh-sound` leaves the
profile clean. Each run used a temporary `DSH_HOME`, deleted after"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"alaxy/dsh-sound` leaves the
profile clean. Each run used a temporary `DSH_HOME`, deleted afterwards."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Dependencies**"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Host half: `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (settings schema) plus the peer
`@deepseek-ai/cordis`. No ot"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"her runtime dependencies.
- Client half: React, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, and
`@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"/dsh-client-ui-settings` are provided by the host application through
the client module table; the p"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"ackage ships no copies of them."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"**Capabilities and permissions**"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Local files: the settings panel opens the browser's own file picker for an audio
file the user sel"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ects; the audio is stored in IndexedDB (`dsh-sound-audio`). There is
no filesystem access outside th"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e browser sandbox and no automatic file scanning.
- Storage: configuration lives in `localStorage` ("},{"id":"p36s4","text":"`dsh-sound:config`), audio files in
IndexedDB.
- No network requests, no external services, no shell"},{"id":"p36s5","text":" or command execution, no
credentials, no native artifacts, and no install lifecycle scripts
(`prein"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"stall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` are absent)."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Failure bounds**"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- Playback failures (browser autoplay policy, unsupported audio) stay silent; the UI
keeps working.
"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"- Unavailable IndexedDB/localStorage degrades to in-memory configuration; unreadable
audio reference"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"s are ignored.
- Unavailable or unparseable event streams degrade to session-snapshot diffing;
malfo"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"rmed frames are ignored without crashing.
- Every configuration read is sanitized against the known "},{"id":"p38s5","text":"field set and defaults."}],"truncated":true}
